about: Hand labels for evidence/default-match.mjs, made 2026-10-26 by reading each pair, no model call. One item per drafted `Decided:` line. match: yes = a test pinning the drafted default passes against the confirmed decision; no = it would not (any sub-decision contradicted); silent = the confirmed source does not decide it (archive only: the human spec has no Decided list, so its text is the confirmed source); added = a confirmed decision the draft never made (counted apart). In-repo confirmed = the developer's -confirmed spec, whose `Changed:` list (runs/<slug>-confirmed/spec/confirmed.jsonl) was the cross-check.

kinds.rule: the behaviour the feature exists for: what is computed, what counts
kinds.invalid-input: input outside the contract or missing: throw, return or coerce, error type and message
kinds.boundary: limits, defaults and their edges, empty and degenerate cases
kinds.text-handling: how input text is read: trimming, case, normalisation, encoding, length unit
kinds.output-format: exact output text: messages, labels, layout, date and number formats
kinds.naming: export names, signatures, constants, package surface
kinds.state: purity, mutability and freezing, caching, persistence, concurrency
kinds.failure-handling: errors from collaborators: store rejections, aborts, inner failures
kinds.scope: what the contract and its tests cover or leave out
